## Names

<a id="room_split_colour_ptrs"></a>
### [`room_split_colour_ptrs`](../../../src/room_split_tables.asm#L6) `$480B-$4832`

*data*

Per room (20 words): 12 bytes = 4 triplets of $D021/$D022/$D023 for the colour bands; irq_frame_top copies them to $0153 every frame.

- **Referred to by:** [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48EE`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L26), [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48F3`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L28), [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48F3`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L28) (+1)

<a id="room_raster_line_ptrs"></a>
### [`room_raster_line_ptrs`](../../../src/room_split_tables.asm#L16) `$4833-$485A`

*data*

Per room (20 words): list of raster lines where the next colour triplet starts, ended by $FD; irq_frame_top copies 4 bytes to $47F5.

- **Referred to by:** [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48F8`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L30), [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48FD`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L32), [`irq_frame_top`](raster_irq_game.md#irq_frame_top) [`$48FD`](../../../src/raster_irq_game.asm#L32) (+1)
